notes.title: Just 1 day until BeatRider launches!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

BeatRider is launching tomorrow! For the first two weeks, you can enjoy a special 20% discount, making it just $9.60! (Prices may vary by region.)

Here, humans coexist with the Kururu—mysterious creatures that can disrupt mental stability and cognitive abilities of humans. 

Embark on a heroic quest to save those who have lost their mental balance.

As more tasks unfold, things start to get weird—the daily life of Baixiang City has been shattered, with chaos popping up everywhere. As you collect more and more investigation archives, you will dive into this strange and fascinating world alongside the Tuners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41753788/013d3ed6f8f15248ed0d1ec4516942e6dc3b6f1d.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Add it to your Wishlist now![/b][/h2]

If you run into any problems, don't hesitate to reach out to us on Discord!

notes.title: 3 days to go! Join BeatRider: save the city from chaos!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Only 3 days until BeatRider officially launches! Are you ready to embark on this thrilling adventure?

Cute warriors, dazzling combos, and dangerous missions await as you uncover the secrets hidden in Baixiang City, where humans coexist with the mysterious creatures known as Kururu!

[h2][b]Release Date and Time: October 23, 2024, 09:00 AM (GMT+8)[/b][/h2]

(6pm PST | 8pm EST | 10 am JST)

The game will support Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese.
